explanation:
Distance of (3, 3) squared is 18.
Distance of (5, -1) squared is 26.
Distance of (-2, 4) squared is 20.
The 2 closest points are (3, 3) and (-2, 4), sorted by distance: (3, 3), then (-2, 4).
Both (1, 3) and (-1, 3) have distance squared 10. Since distances are equal, we sort by x-coordinate: -1 < 1, so (-1, 3) is chosen.
